title: ROMPE · Albion inside Ragnarok · Design explainer

blocks.label: Albion inside Ragnarok
blocks.description: ROMPE is “Albion Online inside Ragnarok Online”: classic jobs, monsters and cards meet a player economy where choosing a place means choosing risk. The design argues that nostalgia alone is a narrow market, while hunting, crafting, trade and loss give players reasons to return. ORO adds these as layers over classic rules. This is an accepted design plan, not a claim that the whole sandbox is shipped.
